portable-smoke.claims: smoke-only; no full formal evidence or release attestation

pr-fast.claims: required bounded safety-only merge gate; no liveness, full formal evidence, or release attestation

pr-publication.claims: reduced bounded release qualification for this declared model set; HandoffctlLiveness is a documented one-process abstraction with complete lifecycle safety invariants and EventualCompletion; neither refinement evidence nor the full two-process lifecycle cross-product, and no full formal or release attestation

full-exhaustive.claims: scheduled/manual advisory exploratory contained bounded model checking; all tracked configurations and the two-process lifecycle aggregate are checked through the exhaustive union of disjoint immutable-operation slices

non_claims: portable-smoke does not prove exhaustive model coverage
pr-publication does not prove the full two-process lifecycle cross-product
full-exhaustive is exploratory supplementary evidence and cannot block normal progression, acceptance, merge, or release
portable address-space limits are not equivalent to cgroup RSS or swap accounting
